content: DRAFT If ComMPncGatewayEnabled is set to TRUE and when the PNC Learning Phase is active and an ER A Rx Signal is received on a channel where ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE ComM shall set PNC - to - channel Mapping to 1 for every ComMPnc on the according channel where this ERA Rx Signal has been received with 1 for the according PNC.
